mentions.name: Monadic DNA
mentions.description: Open, secure personal genomics platform built on fully homomorphic encryption. Users can securely store their genomic data and receive insights without the data ever being decrypted, with a planned protocol to let third-party apps access the data under user consent.
mentions.problem: With 23andMe bankrupt, people lack a secure place to store their genomic data and receive insights from it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Open, secure personal genomics using fully homomorphic encryption.

With 23andMe bankrupt, I want to put out somewhere secure people can put their genomic data and receive insights. In a few months, I'll have a protocol in place to open up the data to third party apps (with user consent). The data does not have to be decrypted ever to be operated upon!
